title: Coordinate expansion of k-covectors on ℝ^P (Fact A)
statement: For all P, k ∈ ℕ and every k-covector α on ℝ^P (a continuous alternating k-linear map (ℝ^P)^k → ℝ, Covector (Eucl P) k): α = Σ_{β ∈ I(k,P)} α(e_{β(0)}, …, e_{β(k−1)})·dx^β. Here I(k,P) = SimonMultiIndex k P is the finite set of strictly increasing maps (order embeddings) β : Fin k → Fin P; e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 is the i-th standard basis vector, so the coefficient is euclideanCovectorCoordinate α β; and dx^β = wedgeCovectors k (j ↦ EuclideanSpace.proj (β j)) is the wedge of the coordinate 1-covectors dx^{β(0)}, …, dx^{β(k−1)}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), α = ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex k P, euclideanCovectorCoordinate α β • wedgeCovectors k (fun j => EuclideanSpace.proj (β j))
